decisive_items: sudden onset of painless bilateral loss of vision immediately after falling
painless bilateral loss of vision immediately after falling approximately 3 meters from a pickup truck
response.rationale: Traumatic optic neuropathy is the most likely diagnosis due to the sudden onset of bilateral vision loss after a traumatic event, despite normal visual evoked potentials. Commotio retinae is a close second, but the lack of specific findings supporting retinal injury makes it less likely.

rejected.why: Normal visual evoked potentials and electroretinography make commotio retinae less likely
Concussion alone does not explain the bilateral vision loss
Normal systemic and neurologic examinations, as well as lack of conclusive psychiatric findings, make conversion disorder less likely
